advisory_findings.observation: strict_json rejects named nonfinite JSON constants but accepts exponent 1e999 as float infinity in unused metadata.
advisory_findings.recommendation: If strict finite JSON is claimed, reject nonfinite parse_float results and guard exponent overflow; otherwise narrow documentation.

blocking_findings.observation: ZipInfo.filename silently truncates the raw member at NUL. A fabricated central/local name FREEZE_RECEIPT.json\0suffix is accepted against a FREEZE_RECEIPT.json inventory.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Validate ZipInfo.orig_filename and require equality with filename before prefix and inventory checks; guard with fabricated raw central/local NUL names.

blocking_findings.observation: Identical fresh --output and --receipt paths pass preflight. Reconstruction creates the ZIP, then receipt preflight raises, leaving a verified output with exit 1 and no printed receipt.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Reject equal normalized output/receipt paths before reconstruct; guard absence of output on this preflight failure.
